title: Pre-Qualification Letter Age at Reinstatement — Homesite Reservation
content:
The reinstatement letter shortening of a reinstated Homesite Reservation hold is set by the age of the pre-qualification letter on the reinstatement date, counted in calendar days from the date printed on the letter, as on the reservation record, to today.

| Letter age on the reinstatement date | Reinstatement letter shortening |
|---|---|
| more than 60 days | 2 days |
| more than 30 days but no more than 60 days | 1 day |
| 30 days or less | zero |

## Boundary days

| Age (days) | Shortening |
|---|---|
| 30 | zero |
| 31 | 1 day |
| 60 | 1 day |
| 61 | 2 days |

## Date example (hypothetical)

A letter dated 10 June and a reinstatement on 10 July: the age is 30 days, so there is no shortening. Reinstated on 11 July instead, the age is 31 days and the shortening is 1 day.
